messages.content: Let me look at the parts on this one.

function.name: get_parts_status
function.description: Returns parts order details for a job: each order's supplier, part number, status (ordered/in_transit/received), and expected arrival date. Use when the CSC asks 'when are parts coming in' or 'are the parts here yet'. has_any_pending = true means at least one order is in transit; earliest_eta_ms is the soonest expected arrival.
